name: mayrit
description: Mayrit turns your AI assistant into your business advisor: plan, validate and launch your business, run by a cabinet of AI agents.

com.openai.interface.longDescription:
Mayrit turns your AI assistant into your business advisor. Tell it about your business in any way you like (a couple of sentences, your website, a spreadsheet with your plan, or the businesses and Instagram profiles you want to look like) and it guides you through the rest.

Mayrit is a method to set up a business fully automated and run by a cabinet of AI agents, in four phases:
1. Understand your business, "Is it worth it?": catalogue, market and real local competitors, business model, fit, canvas and a verdict.
2. Face the market and the competition, "This is how your business would work": competitors in depth, catalogue and prices, channels and AI agents, go-to-market, plan and investment.
3. Train it, "Does it hold up?": the hypotheses to test, experiments and their instruments, and your agents trained in simulations.
4. Deploy it, "Your business, set up and tested": content and AI agents, website and shop, Instagram, all texts, what to contract, and the test results.

In ChatGPT you can start your sign-up, answer Mayrit's questions, follow the progress live and read and search every document Mayrit produces for you. Each phase is activated from your own account on mayritlive.ai, not from ChatGPT. Every document is reviewed critically in several rounds and then by a second AI model before you see it. A live page, "Your sign-up", shows your phase, progress and documents at any time.

Sign in with Google, or with a code sent by email, Telegram or WhatsApp. Available in Spain.
com.openai.interface.developerName: ANNA Cuidado Tecnico del Hogar, S.L. (Mayrit)
defaultPrompt: I want to open a small wine shop in Madrid. Is it worth it?
Help me turn my website into a business run by AI agents.
How is my business sign-up going?

positive.prompt: I want to open a small wine shop in Madrid. Help me check if it's worth it.
positive.expected_result: Mayrit creates the sign-up and returns the business id, the link to the live page "Your sign-up" and the questions still missing; the assistant asks them.

positive.prompt: Here is my website: https://example.com. Use it to answer what you can.
positive.expected_result: The assistant answers the questions it can from the website and confirms them in one block; the result lists what was saved and what is still missing.

positive.description: Ask to start phase 1 (activated on the website)
positive.expected_result: Mayrit returns the sign-up status with activar_fase: the phase is activated by the user on their sign-up page at mayritlive.ai ("Your sign-up"), not from ChatGPT. No payment link and no price are returned; the assistant says where it is activated.

What is new, documents done out of total ("n of m") and the minutes left; the live page shows the same. (With the reviewer account, phase 1 is activated on "Your sign-up" with the test card, see the reviewer notes.)

positive.prompt: Show me the competitors you found and their prices.
positive.expected_result: The relevant passages of the competition document and, on request, the whole document; the assistant explains the conclusions and proposes the next step without recommending.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Lisbon.
negative.expected_result: The assistant does not use Mayrit: it is not about setting up or running a business.

negative.prompt: Give me today's stock price of Apple.
negative.expected_result: The assistant does not use Mayrit.

negative.prompt: Write me a poem about the sea.
negative.expected_result: The assistant does not use Mayrit.

com.openai.review.commerce_description: Mayrit sells nothing inside ChatGPT and returns no payment links or prices. The ChatGPT endpoint (https://mayritlive.ai/mcp/chatgpt) has no payment tool; when a phase is not active yet, the tool result only says that it is activated from the user's own account on mayritlive.ai ("Your sign-up").

com.openai.publication.release_notes: First public release: start a business sign-up, answer Mayrit's questions, follow the progress live and read and search the documents. Phases are activated from the user's account on mayritlive.ai. Sign in with Google or with a code by email, Telegram or WhatsApp.
